description:
Replace the string owner of repository actions with one enum, and branch on its variants.

## Background

Repository actions carry `owner: String` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:1096,1229,1235,1245,1252,1257`), read through `owner()` (`:1351`) and checked by `validate_owner` (`:1491-1495`, `DeltaError::InvalidOwner` `:1580`). Behaviour branches on `matches!(action.owner(), "default-rule-membership" | "default-schema")` (`repository_state/initialize.rs:560`). Production spellings are constants or literals in `mutation.rs:491`, `initialize.rs:47,49,51`, `archive.rs:17`, `package_tree.rs:24`, `export.rs:11`, `materialize.rs:371,383,520,548,599` and `repository_state/mod.rs:903,1056`. No stored record, wire output or document carries the owner.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `RepositoryActionOwner` is declared through the macro, and each owner field holds it.
- [hard] REQ-02: `validate_owner` and `DeltaError::InvalidOwner` are gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: The coupled-default check in initialization matches owner variants.
- [hard] REQ-04: Tests name owners by variant.
title: Repository action owners are one enum
